what: Count triangular flag cloths (7 wide × 9 tall, structure 1 · diagonal .55 · bend .3, damping .982) hang evenly on a rope sagging 4.5% longer (48 Verlet points, damping .988, gravity 900px/s², 24 length-fitting passes) between two points (start·end, board %), and are blown by wind made from three sine noises (horizontal 1250 · vertical 260 · depth 900) — a cloth is pushed more the more it faces the wind (.25~1). When the cursor comes within 140px it pushes the cloth away with force proportional to distance, up to 5200. Fixed 1/120s step (up to 4 per frame). On start it descends from above by board height + flag height after a delay, over .9s cubic-out. Light shades .8~1.08x from the dot product of a fixed light direction and the normal, and depth uses an oblique projection (.34, −.12).

options.slack: Line sag (extra share of length versus a straight line), default .045
options.flag: Flag height (% of screen width), default 3.772
options.entry: Drop-down length (s), default .9 — at 0 it hangs there from the start
options.--fx-flag-1 … --fx-flag-5: Flag colors (css variables, cycled up to five) — if absent, --kf-accent·ink·success·warning·accent-soft

note: Draws nothing without WebGL2. With reduced motion it draws a single sagging shape with no wind·cursor. The original cut the flag shape from the alpha of a curved SVG texture, here the grid itself is narrowed into triangles to get the same silhouette

from.where: Four .hl-bunting at the top of every page (HeroBunting)
